phase: a store that holds agent state
detail: The baseline keeps every agent in an in-process Dictionary<string, Agent> and writes no agent state to disk for the lifetime of the process. There is no store file to remove, lock, or corrupt: properties.db holds property listings only, and an outage of it would test the search tool rather than the durability of an enquiry. Removing it mid-run was not substituted, because a different fault reported under this name would be worse than an honest absence.
